segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, thanks for making time, Dana. I wanted to walk through the proposal for the analytics workspace: 68 seats, annual term starting March 1, and the onboarding package we discussed.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yep, that matches. We have 52 current users and then the finance team adds 16 once we finish the quarter-end close.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Got it. The pricing sheet has 68 seats at $54 per seat per month, billed annually, so the subscription is $44,064 for the year. The onboarding package is a one-time $4,800.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay. And the invoice would come after signature, right? Our AP team needs a PO on it, but we can turn that around pretty fast.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Exactly. Once the order form is signed, billing sends the invoice with your PO number included. Payment terms are net 30, same as your current agreement.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Good. For go-live, we were aiming for March 18. Is that still reasonable if legal signs by next Friday, February 16?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, so if signature is by the 16th, kickoff can be February 21. That gives us three working sessions before March 18: admin setup, data connection, and end-user training.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: That works. I’ll need the training session recorded because our West Coast managers can’t all join at 10 a.m. Eastern.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: No problem. We’ll record it and send the link the same day. We can also include the quick-start guide in the calendar invite.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Perfect. Send me the order form with the 68 seats and March 1 start date, and I’ll route it for signature today.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Will do. I’ll send it over this afternoon, and I’ll include the invoice estimate so AP has the totals ahead of time.
